dimensions.assessment: Affects airports, commercial entities, and passengers utilizing expanded reimbursable screening locations outside standard terminal areas.
dimensions.evidence: allows TSA to be reimbursed for establishing and providing screening services outside an airport terminal's existing primary screening area for passengers.

dimensions.assessment: Extends program duration and allows a moderate numerical expansion in pilot locations from 8 to 14.
dimensions.evidence: striking 'not more than eight' and inserting 'not more than 14'.

dimensions.assessment: Involves TSA providing screening services that are reimbursed by external partners rather than adding net federal appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: allows TSA to be reimbursed for establishing and providing screening services

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing statutory limitations on an ongoing TSA pilot program.
dimensions.evidence: Subsection (e) of section 225 of division A of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2019... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program authorization through fiscal year 2031.

missing_information: Specific names of airports or entities participating in the pilot program.
Total monetary value of the reimbursements.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends the TSA Reimbursable Screening Services Program through 2031 and expands the maximum number of pilot locations from 8 to 14.
